in_sanskrit.name: यशस्
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: यस् शस्तिर् अस्ति तस्य यशः, (yas shasti asti tasya yasha) - 'He has the fame that is worthy of him'

in_hindi.name: यशस
in_hindi.meaning: प्रसाद, प्रशंसा, प्रसन्नता, यश (prasad, prashansa, prasanna ta, yash) - 'Fame, praise, pleasure, and glory'

in_tamil.name: யாஷாஸ்
in_tamil.meaning: பவித்தல், காலை, விருப்பம் (pavittal, kalaig, virupam) - 'Fame, time, and brilliance'

in_telugu.name: యశస్
in_telugu.meaning: యోజనమ్, గౌరవం, ప్రజేశ్యోట్టం, యోజనేదరియ (yoshas, yojanam, gauravam, prajeshvoyottamam, yojanedariyu) - 'Fame, power, prestige, and wealth'

in_marathi.name: Yashas
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Bringer of success
in_marathi.long_meaning: Yashas हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'yash', meaning 'success'. It signifies the bringer of success, prosperity, and victory. It is a powerful name that instills a sense of confidence and courage.

in_bengali.name: Yashas
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Bringer of success
in_bengali.long_meaning: Yashas একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'yash', meaning 'success'. It signifies the bringer of success, prosperity, and victory. It is a powerful name that instills a sense of confidence and courage.

vedic_reference.note: Derived from the Sanskrit word 'yasah' meaning 'fame, reputation, glory'. In Hindu mythology, Yashas is also the name of a sage, who was blessed by Lord Indra for his devotion and was granted the boon of never being forgotten.
